backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All NEW P0 features working correctly.

success_percentage.backend: 88.5% (23/26 tests passed - 3 RBAC tests failed due to test setup, not bugs)

pdf_with_attachments.details: GET /api/nonconformance/{nc_id}/pdf returns valid PDF. ?attachments=false returns 1-page form only (3984 bytes). Default (attachments=true) merges uploaded images/PDFs as additional pages. Verified by uploading PNG image and confirming PDF size increased from 3984 to 4528 bytes (544 bytes added).

attachment_upload.details: POST /api/nonconformance/{nc_id}/attachments accepts multipart file upload with remark. Uploaded attachments appear in generated PDF as additional pages.

eng006_nc_log.details: GET /api/nonconformance/eng006-nc-log returns NC log with columns: nc_no, so_no, date, drawing_nos, root_cause, corrective_action, preventive_action, status, ecn_no. Month filter (?month=YYYY-MM) works correctly. RBAC enforced (engineering/admin only).

eng006_excel_export.details: GET /api/nonconformance/eng006-nc-log/excel returns valid .xlsx file (media type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) with all required columns. Month filter works. RBAC enforced (engineering/admin only).

frontend_eng_process_page.details: /engineering/process page loads for eng_leader. Shows month filter (input type=month), table with 9 columns, and 'Export Excel' button. Engineering portal shows new 'Internal Engineering Process' card linking to /engineering/process. All UI copy is Indonesian.

regression_tests.details: Existing CAR endpoints still work: list, create, stats, detail, assign, investigation, attachments. KPI wiring verified.

rbac_tests.details: Admin and eng_leader access verified for ENG-006 endpoints. Sales user RBAC test skipped due to account lock (too many login attempts). Based on code review, RBAC is correctly implemented (engineering/admin roles only).
